description: Validate a stream subscribe message (or a `channel` + `filter`) with the SAME validator the stream server runs, without connecting. Returns {valid: true, url, subscribe} with the filter exactly as the server will apply it (values normalised, lists sorted, defaults added: hl.fills gets min_usd 1000 unless given), or {valid: false, code, message} with the server's own error (`bad_subscription` naming the key, `unknown_channel` listing the path's channels). `path` checks the channel against the endpoint the connection would use (a channel of another path is `unknown_channel` there). Costs nothing.

channel.description: A stream channel, e.g. `hl.fills`, `hl.liquidations`, `chain.transfers`, `pm.trades`; stream_info lists them all. Used when `message` is not given.

filter.description: The filter object, e.g. `{"wallet": ["0x..."], "min_usd": 50000}`. Used when `message` is not given.

message.description: A whole subscribe message, e.g. `{"action": "subscribe", "id": "w1", "channel": "hl.fills", "filter": {"coin": ["BTC"]}}`. Or give `channel` and `filter` instead.

path.description: The endpoint the connection would use. Default: the channel's own path.

name: stream_check_filter
title: Stream Check Filter
